summary.name: SquirrelMail
summary.one_liner: SquirrelMail is a browser-based IMAP webmail client, and this SourceForge page is its code repository tree showing branches, tags, and trunk.
use_cases: download a snapshot of the webmail code
access a self-hosted browser email client
summary.what_it_does:
This page is a SourceForge code browser view of the SquirrelMail project repository at revision r15060. It lists three top-level entries: branches (last changed 2026-04-12), tags (2011-07-12, which includes the Webmail version 1.4.22 commit), and trunk (2026-04-01). Each entry shows the latest commit message and author. The page offers a Download Snapshot option and a History link. The listing itself does not describe SquirrelMail's features; the awesome-selfhosted listing describes it as another browser-based IMAP client licensed under GPL-2.0 and written in PHP.</what_it_does>
